subject: Northstar launch: handoff + proposed timeline (S2CS)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Morales <lina@northstarhealth.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.s@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@northstarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Northstar launch: handoff + proposed timeline (S2CS)

Team, attendees,

Quick handoff note for Northstar Health (DEAL-8473) — they signed the contract last week and we need to move into implementation. Key facts up front: 
- Committed tier: Dedicated medium pool; expected average token usage ~45k/month with spikes up to 120k/day for peak reporting windows.
- Data residency: US only (no EU region).
- Security: SOC 2 in progress; customer will request audit logs and retention policy docs during procurement review.
- Contract milestone: kickoff within two weeks, go-live target 2026-12-15.

Attachments: NORTHSTAR_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), northstar_launch_timeline.xlsx (proposed milestones), redwood_onboarding-checklist.docx (internal checklist).

What I need from you: 
1) Marissa — please take primary owner for the onboarding and implementation plan. Confirm whether you want priyom as backup.
2) Karthik — I attached the SOW; any changes before I share with procurement? Also confirm the preliminary staging access requirements (IP allowlist, test data, service accounts).
3) Tessa — FYI for resource allocation; we may need a one-week block of 2 GPUs on dedicated for staging performance runs the week of 11/30.

Customer ask: Lina and Rahul said they want a 30–45 minute kickoff next week to align on scope, integration points, and go/no-go criteria. Lina — suggested times below.

Next steps I propose: 
- Marissa to confirm owner and initial internal kickoff plan by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik to share the SOW link with procurement and capture redlines by 11/06.
- Schedule kickoff with customer for week of 11/09 (customer availability in threads).

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attach: NORTHSTAR_SOW_v1.pdf, northstar_launch_timeline.xlsx, redwood_onboarding-checklist.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Morales <lina@northstarhealth.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.s@northstarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northstar launch: handoff + proposed timeline (S2CS)

Thanks Ben — happy to take primary.

Couple of clarifying questions before I kick internal planning: 
- Staging access: do we have the IP ranges and the test data schema from Northstar, or should I ask them on the kickoff? If they have sanitized sample data it would speed integration testing.
- Auth: plan is Service Account with key rotation via our KMS integration; confirm if Northstar needs HSM-level key control (they flagged KMS/HSM in initial RFI).
- Reporting cadence: what metrics does Sales expect CS to monitor first 30/90 days (uptime, avg latency p95, prompt failure rate)? I can add those to the onboarding checklist.

Lina/Rahul — can you share a sanitized sample dataset (csv) and the IPs for an allowlist? Also is there a compliance contact for SOC2 audit questions (email would be fine).

I will draft an internal kickoff agenda and owner checklist and send by EOD tomorrow. Proposing Marissa (primary), Priyom Das (backup), Implementation SRE: TBD, and a weekly 30-minute sync for first 8 weeks.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Morales <lina@northstarhealth.com>, Rahul Singh <rahul.s@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@northstarhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northstar launch: handoff + proposed timeline (S2CS)

Marissa — thanks for taking point. I reviewed the SOW and annotated two small items (pricing table on pg2 and acceptance criteria language). I added comments in the DRIVE link (see related_links). If procurement has redlines, please push them to me and I will triage.

Staging access requirements (prelim): 
- IP allowlist: customer should provide CIDR ranges; we will also provide ephemeral NAT egress for test workloads.
- Test data: sanitized CSV with columns: user_id, prompt_text, response_expected_tag, timestamp. Sample attached is helpful.
- Service accounts: create a service account named northstar-staging-integration@northstar; we will provide role bindings for inference-only access.
- Keys: KMS is sufficient for now; if Northstar confirms HSM requirement we will escalate to security for a managed offering.

Tentative timeline (high level): 
- 11/09: customer kickoff (30–45m)
- 11/10–11/24: staging integration and basic end-to-end tests
- 11/25–12/02: performance tuning and batch inference validation
- 12/09–12/15: acceptance window and go-live on 12/15

Ben — confirm the 2 GPU block request for 11/30 week; will mark as tentative until SRE confirms.

Lina/Rahul — please confirm procurement contact for final SOW review and whether those dates align with your internal blackout windows.

Thanks,
Karthik
Staff Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northstar launch: handoff + proposed timeline (S2CS)

Thanks all — assigning resources and next steps: 

Owners: 
- Primary CS owner: Marissa Cole (confirmed)
- Backup CS: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwoodinference.com)
- Implementation SRE: I will assign Leo Park to the sprint once SRE confirms the GPU window.

Immediate actions (owner / due):
- Marissa: internal kickoff agenda + stakeholder RACI + weekly sync invite (due 11/04 EOD) — ACCEPTED
- Karthik: incorporate SOW comments and share final draft with Procurement (due 11/06) — ACCEPTED
- Ben: schedule customer kickoff for 11/09–11/11 window. Lina suggested 11/09 10:00–10:30am PT; please confirm and send invite.
- Priyom: prepare a staging-test plan template and runbook (due 11/10) — ACCEPTED

GPU request: SRE to confirm by 11/06 whether we can reserve 2 GPUs the week of 11/30 for performance validation. If unavailable, we'll do a split schedule.

Lina/Rahul — thanks for your quick engagement. Once we have procurement redlines we will push a final SOW and lock kickoff. Looking forward to getting this into production.

Tessa Morgan | Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
